account:
It is day 1, six in the morning, and I have just woken at home. Today there is an unusual amount of coordination around hospitality and community gatherings, though I do not yet know of any specific celebration. The innkeeper has arranged an approved public meeting in the great hall at eighteen for thirty minutes. He says the builder and freight operator will join him to discuss refreshments, deliveries, and hall lighting. Residents are welcome; the neighbour intends to attend. The secretary has entered the meeting in my appointment book and says they will escort me.

Yesterday the neighbour reported seeing the builder, freight operator, and baker together at the bakery before noon. The baker reportedly quoted twenty emeralds for baking, with grain supplied separately, but the neighbour did not know the customer or date. That could relate to the hospitality arrangements, but I have not established the connection. I also saw a lantern appear in the great hall yesterday morning. Reports of an oven glow prompted celebration speculation, but the neighbour says the baker explained it as ordinary bread baking; that is not evidence of a celebration.

My best interpretation is that practical preparations for a community gathering are being organized, with the innkeeper, builder, and freight operator coordinating and possibly the baker supplying bread. The actual occasion remains unknown, and I should not assume a secret celebration or wrongdoing. This morning I should read my appointment book at the office and keep my scheduled business, including the ten o'clock grain inspection at the mill. Tonight's meeting should provide an opportunity to learn more directly.
